customer_message.subject: chat – is this a termination?
customer_message.body:
Maeve Gallagher: hi, I rent a small flat at Bergstrasse 36 in Uster from Gerance Bärenplatz AG, 2.5 rooms, just me
Maeve Gallagher: I got an email from the Gerance yesterday saying the building is being sold and that my "rental relationship ends on 31 July 2027"
Maeve Gallagher: it's just an email, nothing on paper, no form. I really don't know if that counts as a termination or if they've actually terminated yet or if it's just a heads-up
Maeve Gallagher: rent's all paid, no arrears, so it's not that
Maeve Gallagher: if it's real I'd need longer to move, I'm recovering from a knee operation and can't carry anything or look at flats properly until spring
Maeve Gallagher: what should I do?
